mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, increasing citalopram plasma concentrations and QT prolongation risk; both drugs have QT-prolonging potential.
action: Monitor ECG and QTc interval; consider alternative antibiotic (e.g., amoxicillin); reduce citalopram dose if combination necessary; avoid in patients with baseline QT prolongation or hypokalemia.
